name: GCE, 6 factors (single zone): 2^(6-1), F = ABCDE, resolution VI, 32 runs per replicate

factors.name: ensemble_size
factors.why: quorum size: proposals and ACKs per write; the two usual production sizes

factors.name: write_ratio
factors.why: share of requests that take the write pipeline (reads stay local)

factors.name: clients
factors.why: below the saturation knee vs well beyond it

factors.name: force_sync
factors.why: removes the fsync from the write path: tests the log-sync stage

factors.name: payload_bytes
factors.why: bytes logged, sent to every follower and synced per write

factors.name: log_disk
factors.why: speed of the device under the fsync (dedicated log disk)
